dct:title: Extension Code Proposal — Infectious Disease Fillers
dct:description: Proposes 9 new ICD-11 extension codes (5 infectious agents, 4 anatomical structures) as descendants of ICD Extension Code (http://id.who.int/icd/entity/1920852714), needed to complete the logical definitions in batch 2026-Q3-logdef-infectious-01. Each proposed code corresponds to a Mondo filler class (NCBITaxon organism or UBERON anatomical structure) that has no existing WHO-FIC Foundation extension code entity equivalent in whofic-2025-05-24-labeled.owl. Originally 28 codes were candidates; WHO-FIC audit found 19 already exist.

icd:scope.icd:constraint: Mondo filler classes used in infectious disease logical definitions that lack an existing ICD-11 extension code equivalent

icd:proposalJustification.description: These extension codes are needed as filler classes in genus-differentia logical definitions for Foundation infectious disease entities. Without them, 9 of 152 proposed logical definitions cannot be expressed using ICD-11-native vocabulary. An audit against whofic-2025-05-24-labeled.owl reduced the original 28 candidates to 9 truly-needed codes.
icd:proposalJustification.precedent: Existing XN codes already cover major WHO-priority pathogens at species level; these proposals extend coverage to clinically relevant organisms and anatomical sites not yet represented.
icd:proposalJustification.naming_convention: Proposed labels follow ICD-11 extension code naming conventions. Each proposed code includes a skos:exactMatch to NCBITaxon or UBERON for interoperability.

icd:downstream.icd:reason: 9 deferred logical definitions in this batch require the proposed extension codes as filler classes
